title: The GiveWP – Donation Plugin and Fundraising Platform plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery…
description: The GiveWP WordPress plugin is vulnerable to a Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) flaw in all versions up to and including 4.16.7.2. This vulnerability arises from missing nonce validation in the give_render_donor_view() function, allowing unauthenticated attackers to reassign donor records to arbitrary WordPress users if a site administrator is tricked into clicking a malicious link. This reassignment changes donor-account ownership and can enable a related account takeover vulnerability (CVE-2026-82675).
